## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 overstates artifact `6b65b4554c22bf53938345f9e460abacf2db8628534848321f6f341af9d73f55`. Its code checks box bases, interval ideals, weights, and degreewise ranks of \(J_v\), but never constructs \(A_+J_v\), quotient presentation matrices, Smith forms, quotient torsion, or quotient ranks.
- The formal graded isomorphism is proved conditionally in artifact `3e8f0b94dfe273a1b6d9eec5a1e7d5e3bc8a404e0a0fbcf8548b9c221e587c22@L14-L48`, with the right-hand \(A_+\) interpreted as \(A^\vee_+\). However, the explicitly required computation capability certificate remains absent.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Execute and persist a task-owned non-self-conjugate check that constructs both degreewise relation lattices \((A_+J_v)_d\) and \((A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee})_d\), computes their exact Smith forms, and compares quotient free ranks and torsion factors, preserving executable code, explicit inputs, captured stdout/stderr, exit status, and stable artifact digest.
